rationale: The preregistered E4b training-seed trigger fired after E4a: regression package effects cross +0.005 and -0.005 and have sample SD 0.0161 > 0.010.

evaluation.pool_status: existing adaptively used development pool; not untouched confirmation
evaluation.metric: record-level foreground MSE with complete-v2 corroborating metrics
evaluation.effect_convention: spatial error minus temporal error; positive favors temporal packaging

training_seed_analysis.summary: arithmetic mean, sample standard deviation and two-sided 95% Student-t interval with df=4
training_seed_analysis.robust_head_shift_rule: Support a training-seed-robust shift only if all five interaction point estimates are negative and the across-seed 95% t interval is entirely below zero.
training_seed_analysis.regression_preference_rule: Call one regression package seed-stable only if all five regression package effects have the same material sign; otherwise report heterogeneity and sign counts.
training_seed_analysis.scope: Within-model clip bootstrap intervals are conditional and are never substituted for training-seed uncertainty.
training_seed_analysis.terminal_rule: E4b ends after seeds 3 and 4 regardless of outcome; no seeds 5+ are authorized by this study.
